notes.title: Update 13: Ardent Explorer
notes.content:
Fair weather to thee, oh Gluttonous Ones! Today’s update is bringing more updates and changes to many visual elements of the UI, including the health and experience UI that guides your way, literally now! Now, shrines revealed on the map will have a small compass marker pointing toward them. On the larger and more exciting side, there are also content updates! New maps, guns, and souls have been revealed in your world. As the fog clears, you will notice the dark and moody Shrouded Cove and Secluded Valley await you. These new maps have different layouts, requiring different strategies to avoid the hungry souls that crave the safety and power granted by your firearm housing.

Speaking of that, there are 4 new guns, with exciting properties and styles made to break the game even more! I don’t want to spoil them here, so hop in, figure out the unlock conditions, and wreak havoc! To pair with these, some new Souls have come in to add more options for customization, meaning the options are greater than ever!! Let us know what you think.

[list]
[*] Overhaul the visuals of many UI elements
[*] Removed the base set of artifacts, artifacts are entirely determined by properties now.
[/list]

[*] Reworked poison debuff for the player
[*] Reworked Tribulations
[/list]

[*] Updated the shooting SFX to have more balanced sound levels
[*] Improved the writing on many artifacts
[*] Pressing escape inside of menus now closes them
[*] Various Performance Improvements
[/list]

[*] Fixed solider/coin charge being way too long

[*] Fixed enemies sometimes not moving toward the player
[*] Fixed not getting the correct amount of soul worth from revelations

notes.title: Update 12: The Beyond Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Exterminators! 

Today’s update is a special one! To start with, we have revamped all of the enemies currently in the game to match the upgraded art for our weapons. With a shiny new coat of paint, the starving souls of the fallen will march toward you with renewed beauty, almost making you sad to destroy such artful renditions of the Old Ones’ will. But once you see the new Bosses barreling toward you, only then can you appreciate the power Their Will can grant upon a wayward soul. 

Moving BEYOND the enemies, a new Tribulation has been revealed: BEYOND!! See what we did there? ;D This new Tribulation adds a new level of difficulty for our hungry Vessels. With steeper enemy scaling, we are introducing a new challenge, and are planning updates coming to add more depth to these brutal levels.

On another note, we have removed the Transmutations, as we felt their attainment relied too much on failing runs to improve them. As a result, we have rebalanced almost every stat in the game to reflect this change in mechanics. On top of this, we have streamlined collecting Runes to be attained as soon as they are unlocked. Oftentimes collecting runes seemed to discourage experimentation, and could even make players feel cheated if they didn’t get the “right” build to survive a Tribulation to unlock them. Now, as soon as you are notified of receiving the Rune, it is unlocked and added to your Armory for the next round.

An important update to the map and how we make them has occurred as well. Previously, we used infinite map tiles that looped around on each other via procedural generation. We have decided to aim for a better player experience with curated static maps with borders. This will enable us to better tune enemy abilities and movement abilities, as well as provide more unique and interesting map gameplay opportunities. You Exterminators will also have to adjust your strategy to account for a slightly more limited travel ability in any one direction so as not to get yourself boxed in.

These changes are a large part of an even larger update. There have been rebalancing, renaming, and performance fixes aplenty to help improve the overall experience. As always, we welcome feedback in our Discord, the Steam Discussion Forums, and through your reviews. You can find the finer details of our many updates below. 

Until next time, E̷̘͔̪͒͝x̷̧͎̃͛͐̈ẗ̸͚̜̲̳̀̔̒e̶̛͇̓r̶̞̓̄̉̚ṃ̵̪̈́͑̈́͠ĩ̶̧̜͇n̸͓̠͌à̵̦̪̆̎t̷̛͈̋̊̄o̷̩̓r̷̞͇̭͉̉s̴̎̆͆̚͜ͅ

[list]
[*] Updated the art of all of the enemies
[*] Added the Beyond
Dev Note: The Beyond is a new tribulation level, going up to Beyond 99
[*] Removed Transmutations
Dev Note: Over the time of the development we have been going back and forth on how to change it or improve it, but it felt more like, oh I have to fail X amount of runs before I get to have fun or a good run. We made tons of balance changes to reflect this change.
[*] Runes no longer have to be taken to victory to unlock
Dev Note: Every rune requiring it be taken to victory was overly punishing, and led to a content draught, where you were not unlocking things as often as you should.
[*] Maps now are a static size
Dev Note: Rather than an endless empty map, we opted to change to medium-sized curated static maps
[/list]

notes.title: Update 10: The Grand Design Part 1
notes.content:
This is Part 1 of our Grand Design Update. We decided not only did our game need improved visuals, but it needed lots of gameplay changes, the following patch notes are structured differently than our usual patch notes. We wanted to provide more insight into the decisions we made. There are a lot more changes than the ones listed.

This update went through a lot of iterations. Some highlights are that we reworked every artifact in the game, doubled enemy counts, cut their health in half, and reduced their speed.

Some insight on our short-term plans, we plan on working on build diversity, balancing, performance, UI Polish, and QoL.

You can always give feedback to us directly on the Steam forums or at our [url=https://discord.gg/jFmPSm9vDd]discord[/url] 

Major Changes
[list]
[*] Removed Curses
Dev Note: Curses were not fun at all, and removing them was the best option.
[*] Debuff Tag is now the Slow Tag and reworked how Slows
Dev Note: Debuff Tag was just a slow enemies tag, so this helps with clarity.
[*] Properties are no longer gained every 6 levels but are added to the normal artifact pool
Dev Note: We felt this limited builds too much
[*] Reworked Boons
Dev Note: Boons didn’t feel good as implemented, it was an artifact you obtained from a map objective, so we reworked them and other existing map objectives
[*] Consolidated many artifacts together
Dev Note: Let’s be honest, so many artifacts we just trash, so we are focusing on having more interesting artifacts, also there was quite a bit of artifacts with negative downsides that didn’t enhance any kind of build, so those negative effects were removed.
[*] Implemented a new system for bosses and enemies increasing the total amount of 20 and adding a 5th boss.
Dev Note: This new system is in its early stages, but with the changes to enemy art and how we handle enemies this will increase the enemy variety, especially as the system becomes more developed
[*] Removed Abilities and ability power artifacts
Dev Note: Abilities went through many design changes throughout development, and they were not hitting the mark, often the effects were not noticed, so we took the effects we liked and turned those into artifacts.
[*] Updated map graphics
Dev Note: The maps needed some visual improvements, and we have more planned!
[/list]

Performance
[list]
[*] Improved performance issues from spawning enemies
[*] Improved performance issues from dashing
[*] Improved performance issues when collecting souls
[*] Improved performance issues caused by the environment
[/list]

Gun Balance
[list]
[*] All Guns: Critical Damage 75% -> 50%
[*] Cathilan’s Repeater: Critical Chance 1% -> 5%
[*] Cathilan’s Repeater: Range 125 -> 110
[*] Goruk’s Doorbell: Damage 6 -> 8

[*] Harrath's Peace: Critical Chance 1% -> 5%
[*] Madrugar: Critical Chance 1% -> 0%
[*] Madrugar: Fire Rate 500 RPM -> 600 RPM

[*] Shrike: Critical Chance 1% -> 5%
[*] Brog’s Motivator: Damage 15 -> 16

[/list]

Soul Balance

[*] Eldritch Soul: Pickup Range 25% -> 20%

Rune Balance

[*] Edge Runner: +1 Damage Taken -> 20% Speed

[/list]
Dev Note: I used this Rune every single run, and I believe that runes should vary depending on what build you want to do, so having a Rune that is something that you always felt you had to grab is not something that I liked.

notes.title: The Sharpshooter Update
notes.content:
Hello, Slippery Slipperoonies!! We are bringing you the smoothest update this side of a Slip and Slide. Dillyo, our resident code monkey, has been hard at work making this updating the most high performing patch you have ever seen. The Dark Ones have some fun in store for you, with a new Vessel and Soul to help bring an end to darkness. 

These performance improvements have allowed us to ramp up the fire rate to match levels not seen since the game was first in development. While it was fun to flood the screen with copious amounts of bullets, we found the 4 seconds per frame was less than optional. Gone are those days, with many performance optimizations in nearly every facet of the game. Lock and load, and ride the recoil straight on to salvation!

Alongside these performance improvements, we deliver to you, Brog’s Motivator, the marksman’s signature rifle. Who is Brog you might ask? Well, that’s a story for another time. Just know that anyone caught in his scope would be expected to be “moving on'' quite quickly. This slower firing, high damage rifle is perfect for those who value critical strikes, with lethal rewards for those who are brave and patient enough to take the shot while stationary.

Last on the highlight list is our new Artifact type, Projectile Tracking. With this, you have learned to curve the bullet, or hone in on the energy of lost souls, whatever floats your goat. This new Artifact deck will grant you soul seeking bullets that can drive their way to the nearest target in their line of sight, giving a literal supernatural accuracy.

As always, we have more great things cooking, and are looking forward to your feedback to help build some crazy possibilities. Our deck expansions are only getting better, and the weapons are only going to get spicier. Expect some updates to the Grimoire, and maybe a new twist to abilities and artifacts soon. Check below for the full patch notes, and keep in touch for more Eldritch evolutions!

notes.title: Update 8: The Seaside Resort Update!
notes.content:
Welcome cosmic tourists! We are happy to welcome you to our Seaside retreat, on the Bleak Coast, where you will find beautiful waves, plenty of starving slimes, and a brand new implement of destruction!! I won’t have to remind you, STAY OFF THE GRASS. 

With this update, our first new map is arriving with a new style for our enemies. We are also building up our build system, with a new weapon property system. With this system, weapons will have properties that determine what effect they will have on the battlefield, and steer them toward specific Artifacts early on. 

Additionally, with a variety of performance improvements, we have been able to increase enemy spawn rates, meaning there will be some serious horde moments ahead of you. 

As always, our detailed patch notes are below. We look forward to your feedback and hope you enjoy the map, weapon, and systems!

[*] Added Bleak Coast Map
[*] Added 1 New Gun (Orik’s Flightline)

notes.title: Update #7: The Gilded Glow-up!
notes.content:
Pleasant Greetings, Soul Thieves!

Today we are bringing you an update to the visuals of our game. We have been experimenting with different lighting and graphics, and think we have found a sweet spot for readability and that special flair we have been aiming for. Our enemy has been reworked to unify their style with the surroundings and give us some flexibility to introduce new ones as the new maps are developed. We have also prettied up the forest itself, as it was long overdue for an update, with a new Spawn, trees, and terrain. The lighting has been adjusted to better highlight the enemy design and environment, though we welcome feedback as always to bring it in line with what works best for all. 

On top of the world and enemy graphics, we are rocking some new weapon graphics for you all to inhabit! We have tried to make the guns stand out more, with unique designs meant to highlight their style and functionality. We wanted to move away from the bright solid colors of the original to give the weapons more of a developed look and bring a little more life to our exterminators.

These changes also go in alongside a plethora of balance fixes and Quality of Life features that we think will help you figure out just what you need to do to break the game a little easier! One of the bigger QoL changes is the addition of the trinket bag. This section will allow you to see all of your trinket effects in one place to get a better understanding of the effects being placed on you.

notes.title: Update #6: The Loretacular update!
notes.content:
Greetings and Salutations, voidlings! We hope you had a great New Year's day! Today we are bringing you a smaller update, but one that we hope will start to give you a deeper glimpse into the world of the Eldritch Exterminators. You know those Dark Ones and Elder Gods we reference? Well, they finally have names! Every God has a “type” associated with them, and these manifest in the artifacts you collect as you strive to pass the tribulations. As you create your builds, you may notice we have changed nearly all of the artifact names to match their rarities better. Barring a few exceptions, mundane Artifacts will be something physical that has an effect due to its properties. For example, a mundane artifact could be a weapon stock that reduces recoil. An eerie artifact will usually be something with some otherworldly power imbued in it. You might find a cursed mask, or a Tome that grants you greater power than worldly items could.

For our Eldritch and Unpseakable artifacts, these are aspects of the Dark Gods themselves, and carry some form of their power based on that aspect.This is meant to give you an idea of what types of powers the Gods are known for in the before times. 

Along with the lore changes, we have added in a ton of balance adjustments and changes to ensure a more entertaining and fair challenge. Along with some prep work for some major changes coming later. ;) 
But more on that later! For now, the patch notes are below, and the changes are in game for your exploration. Let us know what you think, and any ideas you might have! You can provide feedback here or on our Discord!

notes.title: Update #5: The Blood of the Ancients Update is available now!
notes.content:
Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays, Denizens of the Dark! 

On these rapidly cooling days, we bring to you a delightful deluge of changes, fixes, and developments, in the form of our first Major Update!!! 

One of the standouts in this one is the new ability system we mentioned in the last devlog. With this new system, you will be able to equip any ability while using any weapon. We look forward to hearing what synergies work best from you, and watching your triumph over the Tribulations set before you. We have reworked every ability to work with this new system, and are always looking for feedback on each one and their playstyle with different Vessels. 

We have added some new challenges to go with our Bosses, featuring a unique pool of curses for each one, that will be assigned to you upon their defeat on the field of glorious combat. These curses range from buffing the general stats of your foes, to adding unique tweaks to their capabilities based on the boss that was killed.

Fear not, we didn’t just grant the enemy new and terrifying powers to destroy you with! With the new Ichor system, we have added another way to build your power and adapt to the threats you will face. You will collect Ichor Flasks that will combine into a new artifact, forged from the vibrant blood of an Elder God. We will leave it to you to discover what these new artifacts are capable of. >:)


Along with Ichor are Runes! While we mentioned these in our last devlog as being an involved process to acquire, we wanted to get them into your hands for testing before bringing on a more complicated system. For now, they are rare drops from enemies that you have to take to a victory and they can grant you unique effects in your future runs, such as soul magnetism, damage taken to damage dealt exchanges, and more. 

And last on our highlights list, a full rebalance of all Unspeakables. We have been taking your feedback into account and are working to make these powerful artifacts more interesting and exciting when they come up in your deck.Thank you again to our players and contributors, and keep the suggestions coming.

notes.title: The Boss Boogie Update is available now!
notes.content:
Greetings and Salutations soldiers of light and dark! Today we bring you some funky new beats to battle to, along with a new Boss to terrorize you. Keep an “eye” out for him, lest he scare you to your bones! We did a lot of tuning to enemy health and spawn weight. A couple QOL features were added to show you when your dashes are ready to use and what your shield status is. Readability is key, and we want you to know when you are ready to fly or take a hit. 

A lot of tuning around Artifacts happened, with a focus on Rate of Fire, to ensure the builds are more dynamic and everyone doesn’t go for the same artifacts over and over. These, along with the aforementioned spawn and health changes should lead to a more intense and strategic experience in each run. With some new enemy behavior snuck in there, we think there might be some fun scenarios for players to contend. 

We are also expecting a price increase to $4.99 after the Autumn Sale ends, so let anyone who might be interested know to get in before the change!

We have taken your feedback into account and have been working hard to tune the game balance and make some new gameplay additions. We have added health bars for all of the bosses, so you can know when you need to close in for the kill and capture. 3 new unspeakables have been added to help your twisted minds break the game even more! With the new Loot Goblin boon, you will find your trinket collection growing at an alarming rate. We have added new Harmonies to the game to enhance the combo options for artifacts. 

We also heard some requests for improved visibility, so we increased the brightness of the game to give you all better visibility of the slimes trying to devour you. Maybe it will be easier to dodge those blasted Fire Skulls. We also added some visibility to buffs on your HUD, so you can know just how STRONK you are getting.

notes.title: Borne of Wrath and Greed Update available!
notes.content:
We want to start off by thanking everyone who has played Eldritch Exterminators so far! This game is a labor of love for us, and we are excited to see it in the players’ hands now. 

As our first major update, we wanted to make this a special one, and are bringing in a boatload of hotfixes and new content. Our tech-monkey Dylan has been typing away in his dungeon to bring us these new enhancements to the game. We are at 3 pages worth of patch notes, with the biggest additions being a new weapon, Adira’s Wrath, a burst rifle focused around critical hit chance, and its custom soul that can convert any weapon into a 2-round burst. Two new enemies, each with their own unique abilities and mechanics.

Alongside the above are steam achievements, a rework to the trinket collection system, and a variety of balance changes.

For our next major patch, we are working on adding in controller support, 2 new Blast-themed weapons(WHAT COULD THEY BE!?), a full rework of abilities(more on this later), the Blast Artifact tree, shields, rituals, and runes.

Join Our Discord: https://discord.gg/QvJMb2G
